title: license payload
description: What a license file signs (license-file.schema.json's spec.payload, once decoded): whom it is for, its kind, the enterprise features it names per product, its first and last day and the key that signed it (ADR-L1, L4, L6, L8, L9). nw-license writes it and mankit's licenses package reads it. Open: a newer nw-license may add fields here, and an older app accepts them (CT-RULE-4), as several app versions read the org license at once (ADR-S15); the signature still covers the payload's bytes exactly, a field the app does not know included. Two rules no schema can say: until is never before issued, and id is the file's metadata.id.

id.description: The license's id, which nw-license writes, signed so it cannot be changed: the license file's metadata.id must be the same, so a signed id names the file, and mankit refuses a file whose two ids differ (ADR-S15).

kind.description: Which kind of license it is; license-show.schema.json's licenses[].kind says what each kind covers (ADR-L8, L9).

for.description: The person or org the license names, never a machine, so whoever has the file sees whose it was (ADR-L4); never only spaces.

products.description: The enterprise feature ids the license names, per product id, so an app opens a feature only when its own product id names it (ADR-L2). An org license names one or more products, a product license exactly one; a trial key names none, as it opens every enterprise feature (ADR-L9).

additionalProperties.description: The product's enterprise feature ids, as its feature list names them; never empty.

issued.description: The license's first day, an RFC 3339 date in UTC; a trial key runs from it (ADR-L9).

until.description: The license's last day, an RFC 3339 date in UTC, never before issued; after it its features lock again (ADR-L3).

keyId.description: The id of the key that signed it, so an app checks it against the keys its build trusts (ADR-L5, L6).

allOf.description: A trial key names no products (ADR-L9).
A product license names exactly one product (ADR-L8).
An org license names its products, one or more (ADR-L8).
